biocom-convergent-research:lever:c20fa76.description: E11 Bio is a nonprofit organization tackling a neuroscience moonshot: developing a radical technology platform for scalable mammalian brain mapping. E11 is a Focused Research Organization supported by Convergent Research. Our work will have an impact for neuroscience, the next generation of AI, but most importantly for the millions of people who suffer from neurological disorders. We are a collaborative, interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers working at the frontier of connectomics. Read our technology roadmap. E11 Bio is seeking an experienced Operations Lead to manage and mentor a small ops team and provide operational leadership across the organization’s systems. This is a full-time, exempt leadership role responsible for ensuring scientific activities are supported by operational execution, managing the operations team, and building scalable systems that support E11’s continued growth. You will partner closely with scientific leadership to guide planning, manage risk, and ensure that ambitious technical goals are matched by operational rigor. This is an onsite role based in Alameda, CA.

Guide project planning processes across programs to ensure clarity of priorities, timelines, and interdependencies.
Track project status across initiatives, proactively flagging risk and improving cross-project communication.
Reduce organizational risk by daylighting project blockers, coordinating managerial response, and ensuring disciplined follow-through.
Operational & Process Leadership
Directly manage the operations team, including the Scientific Operations Manager, Lab Manager, and Office Coordinator.
Introduce and institutionalize best practices in operational management.
Evolve internal processes to be scalable, robust, and resilient as the organization grows.

Strengthen planning cadence and execution discipline across teams.

Support financial forecasting and expenditure discipline across programs.
Oversee contracts related to partnerships, facilities, vendors, and contractors in coordination with legal and accounting partners.
People Leadership & Mentorship

Offer developmentally relevant feedback and mentorship to managers and senior contributors across the organization.
Introduce best practices in personnel management, performance feedback, and accountability.
Strengthen a culture of professionalism, mutual respect, and operational excellence.
qualifications: Required:
8+ years of experience in operational roles within technical or scientific organizations + a track record of successful operational leadership.
Experience directly mentoring and managing individual contributors.
Strong financial literacy, including budget review, forecasting, and vendor contract oversight.
Experience building or scaling operational systems in a growing organization.
Proven ability to execute strategy through operational excellence.
Demonstrated project management experience.
Experience advising leadership on personnel management.
Strong judgment, risk assessment, and organizational design skills.
Excellent communication skills and ability to build alignment across senior stakeholders.
Ability to work onsite in a highly collaborative, mission-driven environment.

Experienced with meeting management and group dynamics: Driving the agenda, keeping the meeting on track, surfacing action items and tracking them to completion.

Familiarity with capital equipment planning and laboratory infrastructure scaling.

cncf-landscape-canonical-member:greenhou.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Chief Revenue Officer , to lead our enterprise sales, sales development, partner, channel, alliance, customer success and field engineering teams. This position will report to the CEO and collaborate with the most senior leaders of Canonical to drive sustainable growth. Success in this role depends on both operational and inspirational leadership. We see the role as program, process and metric oriented, with leadership and charisma being necessary but not sufficient. It is not itself a sales position so much as one that demands astute planning and tactical operations combined with leadership, rigor and insight into the global dynamics and drivers of enterprise software selection and procurement today. Perhaps unusually we are looking for a leader who is insightful and passionate about the impact of open source in the world . Across every category of compute - from the very lowest-level microcontroller to the fastest CPU's and GPUs, from the biggest cloud infrastructure to the tiniest devices, we see open source growing in both share and reputation. The same is true in every category of business and scientific application. Our opportunity is to deliver the majority of that software globally. Our mission is to do that efficiently, at low cost, in a way that accelerates progress and preserves a level playing field in silicon and cloud. We work closely with both silicon and cloud providers to maximise performance and align with their differentiated offerings. We work to build and sustain trust as the best way for their customers to get the widest range of open source, and the best of their infrastructure and compute capability. As a result, we are growing mind share and market share. This is a tremendous responsibility, but it is also an extraordinary value proposition. gaingels-pyka:lever:a0181e70-1650-4f93-a.description: About Pyka Pyka’s goal is to provide society with a new form of safe, clean, and cost-effective transportation enabled by autonomous electric aviation. To get there, we’re taking a different approach than most. We're applying our technologies to every industry where autonomous electric aircraft can be useful, starting with the highest value and most dangerous jobs. In doing so, we're building game-changing products manufactured at scale, while perfecting the safety, reliability, and capabilities of our autonomy engine and electric propulsion systems. We design, develop and manufacture an ecosystem of technologies including proprietary flight control software, avionics, high power density motors, motor controllers, batteries, and custom carbon-fiber composite airframes. Today, we supply autonomous electric aircraft for cargo transport and crop protection to real-world customers across four separate continents and have secured industry-first regulatory approvals from the FAA. Our cargo aircraft enables remote connectivity, enhances express delivery networks, and ensures fast and reliable shipping of critical supplies to areas in need. Our crop protection aircraft offers agricultural services providers and farmers an autonomous tool to make aerial application safer, more precise, and less harmful to surrounding environments. Both vehicles are highly economical to operate, easy to deploy, and significantly reduce CO2 emissions in their respective industries. What you work on at Pyka makes people’s lives better now and brings the future of electric aviation one step closer each day. Role Overview Pyka is looking for a highly skilled Mechanical Engineer to join our cargo aircraft team. In this role, you will lead the mechanical design and integration of key aircraft components. Your work will span from detailed CAD design to structural analysis, prototyping, and testing — all while collaborating closely with cross-functional engineering teams.
responsibilities: Design mechanical components and assemblies with consideration for aircraft environments and performance.
Perform basic structural and stress analysis (hand calculations and FEA) to validate designs.
Apply GD&T and appropriate tolerancing to ensure manufacturability and proper assembly.
Generate detailed 3D CAD models and engineering drawings (SolidWorks preferred).
Support structural integration of components into composite and metallic airframe structures.
Design basic tooling and fixtures to support prototyping and testing.
Lead hands-on prototyping, assembly, and testing of mechanical systems.
Collaborate with aeromechanical, propulsion, electrical, and manufacturing teams to ensure robust requirement definition and collaboration across systems.
Contribute to design reviews and mentor junior engineers as needed.
qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.
3+ years of mechanical design experience, preferably in aerospace or high-performance vehicle environments.
Strong CAD skills (SolidWorks highly preferred), including modeling of complex assemblies.
Solid understanding of structural design principles and material properties.
Experience with basic stress analysis, both analytical (hand calcs) and FEA (e.g., SolidWorks Simulation, ANSYS).
Practical knowledge of tolerancing, fits, and GD&T.
Experience with component integration into airframes or structural assemblies.
Comfortable with hands-on prototyping, fabrication, and testing.
Effective communicator and team collaborator with a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
Experience working with composite materials and bonded structures.
Familiarity with aviation industry standards and certification practices.
Prior experience designing for lightweight, high-strength applications.
Experience designing tooling or fixtures for small-scale production or testing environments.

Facilitate network-level enrollment outreach initiatives including phone banking, referral calls, door-to-door canvassing, flyering at businesses and daycares, tabling at community events, and supporting school-based enrollment events with the goal of recruiting new students and retaining current Mastery students at priority schools.
Build and maintain partnerships with community centers, pre-K programs, and daycare centers in Camden to generate new student leads and promote Mastery Schools of Camden on an ongoing basis.

Guide prospective families through the full enrollment process by sharing information about school options, supporting application completion, and facilitating a smooth handoff to school-based operations teams for registration.

Manage the lead cultivation process in HubSpot by contacting interested families daily, tracking outreach activity, and meeting weekly conversion and contact goals.
Use phone, text, email, and LiveChat (via HubSpot and EZ Texting) to respond to inquiries from families, students, and community partners in a timely and professional manner.

Provide accurate application support and maintain up-to-date records across multiple enrollment platforms, including Avela, SchoolMint, and Genesis. Ensure confidentiality of all student and family information.
Produce professional written and verbal communications as needed, including family correspondence and recruitment messaging in English and Spanish.
Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional demeanor with families and colleagues at all times.
Collaborate with school-based Enrollment Coordinators, Administrative Assistants, and Network Enrollment staff to advance enrollment priorities across campuses.
Attend all required meetings, trainings, and professional development sessions

Represent Mastery Charter Schools as a knowledgeable and enthusiastic ambassador communicating the organization’s mission, school highlights, and student/family value proposition to the broader community.
Any other duties as assigned by the supervisor.
